title: SymbolicPatternReasoning LabelNoiseCeiling

stats.done_summary: Completed SPR_BENCH benchmark on provided fixed splits. Implemented end-to-end training/tuning/testing script (code/run_spr_bench.py) that concatenates token_* columns into sequences, trains multiple TF–IDF baselines, selects by validation accuracy, reports test accuracy, computes duplicate-contradiction label-noise ceiling, and generates required PNG figures. Outputs saved under outputs/ (results_table.csv, best_model.json, label_noise_ceiling.json, classification_report_best.txt) and figures under report/images/. Final write-up in report/report.md plus appendix report/classification_report.md. Best model: LinearSVM_TFIDF_word (C=0.5) with 68.6% test accuracy vs 70% reference; duplicate-contradiction ceiling ~99.37% overall (very low contradiction rate).
